name: Arabian Petroleum Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Arabian Petroleum Ltd provides Lubricants, Oils, Greases & 
other speciality products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APL is an ISO certified company manufacturing industrial & automotive lubricants under in-house brands Arzol and APL. It is the only Indian company manufacturing the Ceramech Nanotechnology products with a revitalizing effect that ensures anti-wear and restorative properties, increasing efficiency and aiding in fuel saving

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 28.0% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
